svg.aria-label: Halo! I'm anrlldev. Right now I'm building a study-program recommender, a college planner, a chat app that runs on Bluetooth, SQL lessons in Indonesian, and a site for a Japanese club. Every quest card below opens the real site, and the stats further down refresh every day.
